metas.name: Inside Out
metas.description: Since the kids loved Inside Out 2, they will enjoy seeing the original adventure where Joy, Sadness, and the other emotions first learn to work together.

metas.name: Despicable Me 2
metas.description: Since they enjoyed the first Despicable Me, they will love this hilarious sequel featuring more Minions mischief and Gru's turn as a secret agent.

metas.name: Minions
metas.description: A laugh-out-loud spin-off perfect for fans of Despicable Me, following the funny yellow helpers on their own solo quest.

metas.name: Finding Dory
metas.description: The exciting sequel to Finding Nemo that follows the forgetful blue tang Dory as she searches for her long-lost parents.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: They loved Frozen II, so they will absolutely enjoy seeing where Elsa and Anna's magical journey originally began.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A beautiful Pixar film about friendship and summer adventures on the Italian Riviera, perfect for fans of Turning Red and Moana.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: An action-packed, heartwarming fantasy adventure about two elf brothers trying to spend one more day with their late father.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: From the creators of Despicable Me, this funny, animal-centric comedy shows what our pets really do when we leave for the day.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A heartwarming and beautiful adventure across China to help a magical young Yeti return home to his family.

metas.name: Monsters, Inc.
metas.description: A Pixar classic packed with heart and humor about lovable monsters who get their energy from children's laughs instead of screams.

metas.name: WALL·E
metas.description: A visually spectacular, heartwarming Pixar story about a little cleaning robot who goes on a grand adventure across the galaxy.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: A thrilling and touching adventure film about a young Viking boy who befriends a rare dragon, matching the epic scale of Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: They enjoyed the first two Kung Fu Panda films, so they will love watching Po reunite with his biological father and train a village of clumsy pandas.

metas.name: The Lego Movie
metas.description: A hilarious, fast-paced adventure packed with colorful animation, clever jokes, and positive themes that appeal to all ages.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: An incredibly funny, modern, and chaotic family road-trip adventure from the creative team behind Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse.

metas.name: The Peanuts Movie
metas.description: A beautifully animated, sweet, and gentle film about Snoopy and Charlie Brown that is perfect for younger kids.

metas.name: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
metas.description: A delightful, laugh-filled stop-motion sci-fi comedy from the creators of Chicken Run and Wallace & Gromit.

metas.name: Shaun the Sheep Movie
metas.description: An incredibly clever and sweet silent-comedy style claymation movie that is easy to understand and funny for all ages.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: A beautiful Ghibli fantasy about tiny people living hidden in a house, sharing a magical atmosphere with My Neighbor Totoro.

metas.name: Mary and the Witch's Flower
metas.description: A charming and visually stunning fantasy adventure about a young girl who discovers a magical flower, perfect for fans of Kiki's Delivery Service.

metas.name: Puss in Boots
metas.description: The exciting origin story of the beloved hero, ideal for kids who loved Puss in Boots: The Last Wish and the Shrek movies.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: A heartwarming Disney superhero adventure featuring the incredibly lovable, huggable robot Baymax.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: A colorful, video-game themed adventure about a misunderstood bad guy trying to prove he's a hero, perfect for fans of Sonic and Mario.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: A beautiful and funny Pixar classic about a floating house, a wild jungle adventure, and an unlikely friendship.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: An extremely silly and imaginative comedy about an inventor whose machine makes food fall from the sky like rain.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: A phenomenal superhero family adventure that blends high-stakes action with relatable, funny family dynamics.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: A spooky-but-not-scary, fast-paced comedy about famous monsters throwing a birthday party for Dracula's daughter.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A brilliant, funny, and action-packed twist on superhero films where a villain finally wins, but then must learn how to be the hero.

metas.name: Arthur Christmas
metas.description: A highly creative and heartwarming holiday adventure about Santa's high-tech operation and his youngest son's quest to deliver one last present.

metas.name: The Iron Giant
metas.description: A beautifully animated classic about a young boy who befriends a giant, gentle robot from outer space.

metas.name: Elemental
metas.description: A colorful and touching Pixar story set in a city where fire, water, land, and air residents live together, sharing themes with Zootopia.

metas.name: Wish
metas.description: A magical Disney musical about a girl who makes a wish on a star, perfect for kids who loved Tangled and Moana.

metas.name: Orion and the Dark
metas.description: A beautiful, imaginative DreamWorks movie about a young boy overcoming his fears with the help of a friendly embodiment of the dark.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A heartwarming, funny live-action/animated adventure about a polite little bear from Peru trying to find a home in London.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: An absolute masterpiece of family cinema that is even funnier and more heartwarming than the original.

metas.name: The Cat Returns
metas.description: A whimsical, lighthearted Studio Ghibli fantasy about a girl who is whisked away to a magical kingdom of talking cats.

metas.name: Over the Moon
metas.description: A gorgeous, vibrant animated musical adventure inspired by Chinese mythology, perfect for fans of Moana and Coco.

metas.name: Ron's Gone Wrong
metas.description: A funny and sweet movie about a socially awkward boy who befriends a malfunctioning, quirky robot device.

metas.name: Leo
metas.description: A very funny and sweet animated musical comedy about a class pet lizard who gives wise life advice to elementary schoolers.

metas.name: Next Gen
metas.description: A fun, futuristic sci-fi action comedy about a rebellious girl and a runaway combat robot who team up to save the city.
